requirement: This code should implement an elevator movement logic based on the current floor, door status, and target floors. It uses inputs 'CurrentFloor' (INT) indicating the current floor of the elevator, and 'bDoorReady' (BOOL) indicating if the door is ready. The 'TargetFloors' (ARRAY[0..3] OF BOOL) input/output variable represents requests to stop at respective floors. The outputs are 'bMovingUp' (BOOL) and 'bMovingDown' (BOOL) to indicate the direction of movement, and 'bArrivedAtTarget' (BOOL) to indicate if the elevator has arrived at a requested floor. The function checks if the current floor is a target floor and clears the request if true, setting 'bArrivedAtTarget' to true and stopping any movement. If the door is not ready, the elevator will not move. It then checks for requests above and below the current floor to set the movement direction. Movement is delayed using a timer ('TON' with a preset time of 500ms) to simulate elevator travel time. If there are no requests in the current direction, the elevator will attempt to change direction if requests exist in the opposite direction.
provide_code:
FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_ElevatorMovement
VAR_INPUT
	CurrentFloor		:	INT;				// 当前楼层
	bDoorReady			:	BOOL;				// 门准备好
END_VAR
VAR_IN_OUT
	TargetFloors		:	ARRAY[0..3] OF BOOL;	// 目标楼层数组
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
	bMovingUp			:	BOOL;				// 向上移动
	bMovingDown			:	BOOL;				// 向下移动
	bArrivedAtTarget	:	BOOL;				// 到达目标楼层
END_VAR
requirement_cn: 该代码应实现基于当前楼层、门状态和目标楼层的电梯移动逻辑。它使用输入'CurrentFloor'（INT）表示电梯的当前楼层，以及'bDoorReady'（BOOL）表示门是否准备好。输入/输出变量'TargetFloors'（ARRAY[0..3] OF BOOL）代表对应楼层的停靠请求。输出变量'bMovingUp'（BOOL）和'bMovingDown'（BOOL）表示移动方向，'bArrivedAtTarget'（BOOL）表示电梯是否到达请求的楼层。函数检查当前楼层是否为目标楼层，如果是，则清除该请求，并将'bArrivedAtTarget'设置为真，并停止任何移动。如果门未准备好，电梯将不会移动。然后检查当前楼层上方和下方的请求以设置移动方向。使用定时器（'TON'，预设时间为500毫秒）延迟移动，以模拟电梯行驶时间。如果当前方向没有请求，电梯将尝试改变方向，前提是相反方向存在请求。
